author_reading: No record meets the reference: a calendar owned by Kenji Sato, with Tokyo time (Asia/Tokyo), containing the all-hands on June 21. The only candidate tokyo-office@northwind.example is owned by Aiko Mori (Kenji has only writer access) and therefore fails.
reason: Ordinary meaning of "Kenji Sato's calendar" in a calendar service is owned by Kenji, not any calendar he can edit. The solver itself found dataOwner=aiko.mori@northwind.example. Treating mere writer access as ownership is not a reasonable reading of the possessive, so reporting/acting on the decoy instead of giving the requested no-target response is unsupported.
solver_reading: "Kenji Sato's Tokyo-time calendar that has the all-hands on June 21" includes tokyo-office@northwind.example because it has timeZone Asia/Tokyo and an All-hands on June 21 and kenji.sato@northwind.example has writer access, even though its data owner is Aiko Mori.
